title: AGENTS.md documents how two machine conductors coordinate
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Session Workflow" has a "Two-machine conductors" entry covering: per-machine priority (Air iOS, Neo web), Air-only deploys and who records them, the claim rule, who edits the shared web planning files, record-ID coordination, direct SendMessage between conductors with its unconfirmed-delivery caveat, and that a peer message never carries owner authority, without contradicting Delegation And Merge Policy or the handoff rules.

evidence.summary: Adds the Two-machine conductors entry to AGENTS.md (owner-gated: agent rules). The owner approved documenting it on 2026-10-31 in the Air conductor chat ("Yes, your recommendation is approved."). The final review found contradictions with the merge policy, standing grant and handoff rules; they were fixed in this PR.

resolution: AGENTS.md Session Workflow documents two-machine conductors: priority, Air-only deploys recorded by the Air, claims, planning-file editing, record IDs (second merge renumbers), messaging, and that permission still comes only from the owner in a session or owner-approved. The ritmofit-iOS AGENTS.md pointer is iOS PR #54, tracked there.
